shots.talk_a: Webcam view, static camera at eye level, of a young adult streamer with short curly dark hair, large white over-ear headphones and a mustard yellow hoodie, sitting in a black gaming chair at a desk in a small bedroom studio lit by purple and teal LED light strips, a black microphone on a boom arm in front of them. They talk cheerfully to the camera, smiling and gesturing with both hands.
